name: CLI-Anything
description: Generates agent-usable CLIs for desktop apps, codebases and web APIs, and installs ready-made ones from the CLI-Hub registry, for developers who want agents to drive GUI software.

skills.name: Generate a CLI
skills.description: Generates a complete agent-native CLI for a desktop app, codebase or web API through a seven-phase build, test and publish pipeline.

skills.name: Refine a CLI
skills.description: Refines a generated CLI by analyzing gaps against the software's full capabilities, or by targeting one functionality area.

skills.name: CLI-Hub Package Manager
skills.description: Browses, searches, installs, updates and launches community-built and public CLIs from the CLI-Hub registry with one command.

skills.name: CLI-Hub Meta-Skill
skills.description: Finds and installs the right CLI from CLI-Hub for a task, through a skill for Claude Code, Codex and other SKILL-compatible agents.

skills.name: SKILL.md Generation
skills.description: Generates a SKILL.md for each built CLI with its command groups, usage examples and JSON output guidance for agents.
